name: 会話内のリンクプレビュー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE existing Lighthouse component LH03-0010「会話内のリンクプレビュー」.
PRIMARY ORIGINAL Image1 governs glyph/placeholder anatomy, optical proportions, alignment, spacing and fine detail. Image2 mock is secondary for Japanese content/typography/layout only; do not copy its mint left stripe or missing provider icon. Image3 style only.
Pure white landscape3:1 canvas with one compact link-preview block, logical390x136px composition. Thin3px neutral-gray vertical rule116px tall at left, slightly rounded ends, then content column. Provider row has ORIGINAL small blank neutral-gray square placeholder icon and exact「ライトハウス｜資料」in MeiryoRegular12/16 tracking0, supporting gray. No invented logo.
Below, forest-green #1F6444 linked title in MeiryoBold20/28tracking0, EXACT THREE lines:
チームで考える
ワークショップの
進め方
Keep title logical244px wide/84px high. At upper right retain source38x38px blank gray rounded-square thumbnail placeholder. Original thumbnail is blank; do not invent artwork/play button. Use ORIGINAL's neutral rule and source icon/thumbnail spacing; preserve Japanese wrapping and complete glyphs.
Color decision: source blue denotes a clickable title, coherently adapted to forest green. Ordinary rule/placeholders remain neutral; no mint, broad colored surface, random icon accent or added primary action. White surfaces, fine restraint, little or no shadow. No unnecessary enclosing card around the entire block.
One component centered with modest white margins, uniformly enlarged. Exclude post author/avatar/body/replies and all other screen content. No extra labels, metrics, buttons, screen frame or variation panels.
reviewNotes: 原画像の中立な区切り線・提供元の小さな空四角・実際の空サムネイル状態を主参照として復元。モックは日本語内容と20/28題名3行、12/16提供元の副参照。実画像を目視し全文・3行・枠や線の静かな扱いを確認。元の青いリンクは森林緑へ意味を維持して適応、余計な主要ボタンなし。正確な書体計測、リンク動作・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: primary original: link-preview anatomy, provider placeholder/fine details
secondary mock: exact localized text/typography and logical proportions
